scope: Read-only layout cardinality/growth/allocation audit. No production candidate, CPU comparison, PB/TS ranking or Decode changes.
errorCases: byte budget early in large array
assertions: hook source only in diagnostic archive; baseline Go source matches committed tree
diagnostic wire equals unmodified baseline, len/cap preserved in measured entry
layout cursor consumes all recorded entries on success
replayed growth equals original final capacity
error class/message and nil result agree with original
do not infer runtime allocator size classes from requested capacities alone
preserve all allocation observations, including non-integral tails
